Container.Name: AirWiggler
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music library and player in a single container. Point it at a folder of music, open a browser, and play. Supports multiple quality tiers (e.g. FLAC and MP3) so users can pick the best option for their connection. Minimal configuration required.

Config.Name: Music Path
Config.Description: Path to your music library on the host.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port to access the web UI.

Config.Name: SITE_TITLE
Config.Description: Title shown in the browser tab and UI.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_QUALITY
Config.Description: Which quality folder to select by default. Will match a subfolder name (e.g. high, medium, flac, mp3).

Config.Name: ACCESS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional shared token to restrict access. Share the app URL as https://yourdomain.com/?token=YOUR_TOKEN. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: ALBUM_ACCESS_TOKENS
Config.Description: Optional album-only shares as comma-separated album-id=token pairs. Share as https://yourdomain.com/?album=ALBUM_ID&token=TOKEN. See README for details.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to false when running over plain HTTP on a local network only. Must be true when exposed via HTTPS.

Config.Name: NOTIFY_URL
Config.Description: ntfy topic URL for push notifications on suspicious activity (e.g. https://ntfy.sh/your-unguessable-topic). Leave blank to disable. See https://github.com/kentonbandy/AirWiggler/blob/main/docs/notifications.md

Config.Name: NOTIFY_BRUTE_FORCE_THRESHOLD
Config.Description: Number of failed token attempts within the rate-limit window before a brute-force alert is sent.

Config.Name: NOTIFY_AUTH_GRANT_THRESHOLD
Config.Description: Number of successful auth grants before an alert is sent.

Config.Name: APP_PORT
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Must match the port mapping above.

Config.Name: RESCAN_ON_START
Config.Description: Scan for new or changed albums when the container starts.

Config.Name: RESCAN_INTERVAL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How often (in minutes) to automatically re-scan the music folder.
